crop.notes: Sporting Notes column; Allen's notice is the first item, the rest is unrelated sports news

ocr.notes: Allen item garbled ('champion goats', 'nota pillow Se gee Se 618 rket', 'test new songs' for 'Latest new songs'); rest mostly readable

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's Sporting Notes carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world, not a pillow champion," at 618 Market Street, with a concert every evening and the latest new songs.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, February 4, 1893

facts.fact: Allen advertised himself as "retired champion pugilist of the world, not a pillow champion," with a concert every evening at his Market Street hall

notes: The image clearly prints 618 Market street; the other notices (884-886) say 619, so 618 is probably a misprint.
